variables.physical_definition: First-order absolute moment of height fluctuations (mean absolute deviation of surface height)
Peak-to-valley height (maximum vertical distance between highest peak and lowest valley of the surface)
Root-mean-square height (square root of mean squared deviations of surface height)

Kurtosis of height fluctuations (dimensionless fourth standardized moment)
Effective streamwise slope of the roughness (mean slope in the flow direction, rise/run)
Surface porosity (fraction of surface area that is void/open)

variables.physical_definition: First-order absolute moment of height fluctuations (mean absolute deviation of surface height)
Peak-to-valley height (maximum vertical distance between highest peak and lowest valley of the surface)
Root-mean-square height (square root of mean squared deviations of surface height)
Third central moment of height fluctuations divided by the cube of their root-mean-square height (dimensionless skewness measure)
Kurtosis of height fluctuations (dimensionless fourth standardized moment)
Effective streamwise slope of the roughness (mean slope in the flow direction, rise/run)
Surface porosity (fraction of surface area that is void/open)

result.basis_precision_note: basis_matrices stores full floating-point precision; basis_matrices_display is rounded for display only.
